result.topic_en: Calculations with a second-order linear ODE of hypergeometric type in y, solved by power series and expressed via Riemann's P-function, followed by computations with logarithmic derivatives of quantities t, ε, α.
result.transcription:
$\frac{\partial \sqrt{y(1-y)}[-\ldots-] \frac{\partial u}{\partial y}\sqrt{y(1-y)}[-\ldots-]}{\partial y} - (\sigma(\sigma+\tfrac12)y [-+-]\kappa\kappa)u = 0$
$(x=0)$
[-$(1-y)\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial \log y^2} + \tfrac12 y\frac{\partial u}{\partial \log y} - (\sigma(\sigma+\tfrac12)y + \kappa\kappa)u = 0 \quad u = \sum a_\mu y^\mu$-] $\sum\big((\mu(\mu+\tfrac12) - \sigma(\sigma+\tfrac12))a_\mu y^{\mu+1} + a_\mu(\mu\mu+\kappa\kappa)\big)y^\mu$
[-$(1-y)\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial \log y^2} + \tfrac12 y\frac{\partial u}{\partial \log y} - (\sigma(\sigma+\tfrac12)y + \kappa)u = 0 \quad \sum$-] $\quad (\mu+\sigma+\tfrac12)(\mu-1)a_{\mu-1} = a_\mu(\mu-\kappa)(\mu+\kappa)$
$a_\mu\frac{\Pi(\mu-\kappa)\Pi(\mu+\kappa)}{\Pi(\mu-1)\Pi(\mu+\sigma-\frac12)} = c. \quad u = \sum\frac{\Pi(\mu-1)\Pi(\mu+\sigma-\frac12)}{\Pi(\mu-\kappa)\Pi(\mu+\kappa)}y^\mu = P\begin{pmatrix}\kappa & \sigma+\frac12 & 0\\ -\kappa & -\sigma & \frac12 & y\\ 0 & \infty & 1\end{pmatrix}$
$y = \kappa y' \quad \frac{\partial\sqrt{y'(1-y')}\frac{\partial u}{\partial y'}\sqrt{y'(1-y')}}{\partial y'} + \kappa\kappa u = 0 \quad u = e^{\kappa i\int\frac{\partial y'}{\sqrt{y'(1-y')}}}$
$= e^{2\kappa i \,\mathrm{arc.sin}\sqrt{y'}} = (\sqrt{1-y'}+\sqrt{y'}\,i)^{2\kappa}$
$y^0 \ldots a(1-y)^0 + b(1-y)^{\frac12} \qquad y'^0 \ldots a(1-y')^0 + b\,\kappa^{\frac12}(1-y')^{\frac12}$
$y^{\frac12} \ldots c(1-y)^0 + d(1-y)^{\frac12} \qquad y'^{\frac12} \ldots c\,\kappa^{-\frac12}(1-y')^0 + d(1-y')^{\frac12}$
[-$\log$-] $\alpha_2 - \varepsilon\alpha_1 = t \qquad\qquad \alpha_2 - \varepsilon\alpha_1$
$\log t + \log t + 2\log\varepsilon \qquad\qquad \left(\frac{\partial\alpha_2}{\partial x} - \varepsilon\frac{\partial\alpha_1}{\partial x} - \varepsilon\frac{\partial\log\varepsilon}{\partial x}\alpha_1\right)(\alpha_2 - \varepsilon^{-1}\alpha_1)$
$\frac1t\frac{\partial t}{\partial x} + \frac1t\frac{\partial t}{\partial x} + 2\frac{\partial\varepsilon}{\varepsilon\partial x} \qquad - \left(\frac{\partial\alpha_2}{\partial x} - \varepsilon^{-1}\frac{\partial\alpha_1}{\partial x} + \varepsilon^{-1}\frac{\partial\log\varepsilon}{\partial x}\alpha_1\right)(\alpha_2 - \varepsilon\alpha_1)$
$\frac1t\frac{\partial^2 t}{\partial x^2} - \frac1{tt}\left(\frac{\partial t}{\partial x}\right)^2 + \frac1t\frac{\partial^2 t}{\partial x^2} - \frac1{tt}\left(\frac{\partial t}{\partial x}\right)^2 + 2\frac1\varepsilon\frac{\partial^2\varepsilon}{\partial x^2} - \frac1{\varepsilon\varepsilon}\left(\frac{\partial\varepsilon}{\partial x}\right)$
$\left(\frac1t\frac{\partial^2 t}{\partial x^2} - \frac1{tt}\left(\frac{\partial t}{\partial x}\right)^2\right)\frac{1\,\partial\varepsilon}{\varepsilon\,\partial x} + \frac{\partial t}{t\,\partial x}\left(\frac1\varepsilon\frac{\partial^2\varepsilon}{\partial x^2} - \frac1{\varepsilon\varepsilon}\left(\frac{\partial\varepsilon}{\partial x}\right)^2\right) \qquad -\varepsilon\alpha_2\frac{\partial\alpha_1}{\partial x} - \varepsilon\frac{\partial\log\varepsilon}{\partial x}\alpha_1\alpha_2 - \varepsilon^{-1}\alpha_1\frac{\partial\alpha_2}{\partial x}$
$+\varepsilon^{-1} \qquad - \varepsilon^{-1}\frac{\partial\log\varepsilon}{\partial x}\alpha_1\alpha_2 \quad +\varepsilon$
$2\frac{\partial\alpha}{\partial x} = \varepsilon - \frac1\varepsilon\;\frac{\partial\log\varepsilon}{\partial x} \qquad \varepsilon^{-\frac12}\alpha_2 - \varepsilon^{\frac12}\alpha_1 = \alpha \qquad +2\frac{\partial\log\varepsilon}{\partial x}\alpha_1^2$
$2\frac{\partial^2\alpha}{\partial x^2} = \left(\varepsilon - \frac1\varepsilon\right)\frac{\partial^2\log\varepsilon}{\partial x^2} + \left(\varepsilon + \frac1\varepsilon\right)\left(\frac{\partial\log\varepsilon}{\partial x}\right)^2$
$\left(\varepsilon - \frac1\varepsilon\right)^3\frac{\partial^2\log\varepsilon}{\partial x^2} = 2\left(\varepsilon - \frac1\varepsilon\right)^2\frac{\partial^2\alpha}{\partial x^2} + \left(\varepsilon + \frac1\varepsilon\right)4\left(\frac{\partial\alpha}{\partial x}\right)^2$
$\left(\varepsilon - \frac1\varepsilon\right)^3\frac{\partial\log\varepsilon}{\partial x} = 2\left(\varepsilon - \frac1\varepsilon\right)^2\frac{\partial\alpha}{\partial x}$

methods.what: Power-series (Frobenius) solution of a hypergeometric-type ODE via a two-term recurrence for the coefficients
Closed form of the coefficients with the Gauss Pi-function and identification of the solution with a Riemann P-function
Limiting (confluent) case obtained by rescaling y = κy', giving an elementary solution via arcsine
Local behaviour of the branches at the singular points before and after rescaling
Relation between the derivatives of α and log ε
